WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    f.rebtotal,
    f.rebrate,
    f.feerate,
    o.ordertune
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(rebtotal) as baseline_rebate
  FROM matched_fees
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    ordertune,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebate,
    AVG((rebrate - feerate) / feerate) as avg_relative_gap
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune
)
SELECT 
  gs.orderslink,
  gs.ordertune,
  gs.avg_rebate,
  gs.avg_relative_gap,
  gs.avg_rebate - b.baseline_rebate as excess
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE gs.avg_rebate > b.baseline_rebate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;
